gui_context: 研究中心展示的化石通用说明；同一段也用于玩家持有的化石，不按容器格子复制。

lines.text: The webbed foot of a small, agile creature which was a strong swimmer.
lines.gloss: 描述化石，不是玩家的装备属性。
lines.zh: 小而敏捷的生物留下的蹼足;它生前一定很擅长游泳。

lines.text: The ugliest fossil to ever exist. It has a face only a mother could love.
lines.zh: 大概是史上最丑的化石了。那张脸,恐怕只有它妈妈才会喜欢。
samples: §7The ugliest fossil to ever exist. It
§7has a face only a mother could love.

lines.text: A great and powerful tusk belonging to a now-extinct creature.
lines.gloss: tusk 为长牙，不是武器牙刃。
lines.zh: 一根硕大而有力的长牙,属于某种早已灭绝的生物。

lines.text: A well-preserved set of neural spines. Whatever possessed these was an adept swimmer.
lines.gloss: neural spines 为背部骨刺，不是神经系统本身。
lines.zh: 一组保存完好的背部骨刺。长着它们的生物想必是游泳好手。

lines.text: The daunting footprint of what was once a colossal and bloodthirsty predator.
lines.zh: 一个令人望而生畏的脚印,属于曾经体型庞大、嗜血成性的掠食者。

lines.text: A tail ending in a thick club that was used to fend off predators.
lines.zh: 尾端长着厚重骨槌,曾用来抵御掠食者。

lines.zh: 还不知道去哪找化石? 这本指南正好能帮上忙!
